ov: العودة إلى بولين ( بالفرنسية: Retour à Bollène ) هو فيلم فرنسي مغربي صدر عام 2017 من تأليف وإخراج وإنتاج المخرج المغربي الفرنسي سعيد حميش بن العربي.
plotEn: The film follows the story of Nassim, a 30-year-old man who returns to his hometown of Bollène, only to find it in a state of devastation under the rule of the League of the South, and a strained relationship with his father. Nassim, who now resides in Abu Dhabi with his American fiancée, confronts the challenges of his past and present as he navigates through the social and political issues of his hometown.
